headline_hook: Claude Code Goes Full Auto While Oracle Bans AI From OpenJDK

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Oracle's OpenJDK ban isn't really about code quality — it's the first major open-source project to confront the provenance crisis that AI-generated code creates for licensing, attribution, and legal liability, and every OSS maintainer is watching to see if this stance holds or collapses under contributor pressure.

model_literacy.relevance: Claude Code defaulting to auto mode, Kitesurf sandboxing agents in V8 isolates, and self-hosted compute all revolve around the same question: how much autonomy do you grant an AI agent, and what guardrails contain the blast radius when it acts on its own?

items.title: Claude Code Flips Auto Mode to Default for All Paid Plans
items.angle: Autonomous coding just became the default workflow for every Claude Code user — Anthropic is betting that the guardrails are ready for prime time
items.key_fact: Auto mode is now on by default for Pro, Max, and Team plans

items.title: Claude Code Now Runs on Your Own Infrastructure

items.title: Cloudflare Launches Kitesurf, a Browser Built for AI Agents
